violations.description: Hardcoded secret API key committed in configuration file.
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secret from repository history, revoke the key, and load credentials from environment variables or a secrets manager.

violations.description: Workflow configures overly permissive write-all permissions.
violations.recommendation: Adopt the principle of least privilege by specifying only required workflow permissions (e.g. contents: read).

violations.description: Test step execution masks build and test failures with continue-on-error.
violations.recommendation: Remove continue-on-error: true from test execution jobs so regression failures properly fail CI gates.

violations.description: Unpinned package dependencies permit non-deterministic and breaking package updates.
violations.recommendation: Pin package version constraints using semantic version bounds (e.g., flask>=3.0.0,<4.0.0).

violations.description: Machine-specific hardcoded absolute path found in settings.
violations.recommendation: Use relative paths or configure directory paths through environment variables.

violations.description: Repository root lacks project documentation and usage instructions.
violations.evidence: No README or README.md discovered in repository root.
violations.recommendation: Add a comprehensive README.md describing project setup, prerequisites, testing, and contribution instructions.
